title: Wordfence Security Setup
description: Harden a client site with Wordfence — firewall, scan schedule, login security, and alerts.

steps.title: Activate Wordfence License
steps.instructions: Install Wordfence and connect a Premium license if the client has one. Confirm firewall and scan definitions update automatically.

steps.title: Enable & Optimize Firewall
steps.instructions: Set firewall to Extended Protection if compatible with hosting. Whitelist agency IPs and critical API endpoints used by integrations.

steps.title: Schedule Malware Scans
steps.instructions: Enable scheduled scans during low-traffic windows. Include core, plugins, themes, and suspicious options in scan scope.

steps.title: Configure Login Security
steps.instructions: Enable brute-force protection, lockout thresholds, and 2FA for administrator roles. Block common username attacks.

steps.title: Set Alert Recipients
steps.instructions: Route critical alerts to agency and client technical contacts. Avoid alert fatigue by limiting non-critical email noise.

steps.title: Review Blocking & Rate Rules
steps.instructions: Add country or IP blocks only when justified. Confirm legitimate payment webhooks and REST callbacks are not blocked.

steps.title: Run Initial Full Scan
steps.instructions: Run a full scan before go-live. Resolve any critical findings, outdated abandoned plugins, and weak passwords.
